views.label: Registration to exit
views.note: The ordered path from staking in to releasing the stake. set_stake changes the stake for new agreements at any point on it.

views.label: One-step exit
views.note: deregister_provider fails while committed_bytes > 0 or pending_challenges > 0; then it releases the stake at once.

views.label: Slash path
views.note: Only a timeout slashes: after the deadline, anyone calls resolve_expired_challenge and the entire stake is slashed.

cards.title: Entry and stake
items: register_provider: stake >= MinProviderStake; no stake-per-byte rule, max_capacity is advisory
set_stake raises at any time; lowering needs an inactive higher_stake_lock (StakeStillLocked otherwise) and bumps version
Each agreement snapshots the stake at creation; the old figure stays locked until cur_until, the latest expiry struck under it, and while a challenge against the provider is open
A registered physical provider may also join a virtual provider (join_virtual)

cards.title: One-step exit
items: deregister_provider fails while committed_bytes > 0 (agreements not settled) or pending_challenges > 0; a member also needs no Active and no active Leaving entry. Then the stake is released immediately
To offboard, stop accepting new agreements and extensions (accepting_primary = false, replica_sync_price = None, accepting_extensions, set_extensions_blocked) and let agreements expire
An open challenge keeps the stake locked, not the payment; the provider may call resolve_expired_challenge against itself to release its locks
refund_agreement returns the remaining payment to the owner; the agreement stays live and challengeable

cards.title: Slash path and terms
items: Only a timeout slashes: an invalid response is rejected and the challenge stays open until the deadline
After the deadline anyone calls resolve_expired_challenge: entire stake to the Treasury, challenger deposit refunded
remove_slashed (anyone, physical providers only): valid on a live agreement whose snapshotted stake is above locked_stake; the remaining payment returns to the owner
Below MinProviderStake the provider takes no new or extended agreement until it raises its stake (StakeBelowMinimum)
Worse terms bump ProviderInfo.version (price up, replica_sync_price up, stake down, a slash); clients pin it as expected_version
